# Additional private subnet pair for a new node pool.
#
# Carved from the last free /19 block of the VPC CIDR (index 7). Blocks 1-3 are
# the module.vpc private subnets and 4-6 are aws_subnet.eks_private, so block 7
# is split into two /20s, one per AZ (eu-west-2a and eu-west-2b).

resource "aws_subnet" "nodepool_private" {
  count = 2

  vpc_id                  = module.vpc.vpc_id
  cidr_block              = cidrsubnet(lookup(local.vpc_cidr, terraform.workspace, local.vpc_cidr["default"]), 4, count.index + 14)
  availability_zone       = var.availability_zones[count.index]
  map_public_ip_on_launch = false

  # No "kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb" tag: internal load balancers should keep
  # landing on the existing private subnets.
  tags = merge({
    Name       = "${local.vpc_name}-nodepool-private-${var.availability_zones[count.index]}"
    SubnetType = "EKS-Private"
    Terraform  = "true"
    Cluster    = local.vpc_name
    Domain     = local.vpc_base_domain_name
  }, local.cluster_tags)
}

resource "aws_route_table_association" "nodepool_private" {
  count = 2

  subnet_id      = aws_subnet.nodepool_private[count.index].id
  route_table_id = module.vpc.private_route_table_ids[count.index]
}
EOF
